title: Cultural field of electoral turnout in Costa Rica, 2010-2026: derived data and analysis code
description: Derived district-level tables, Lasker isonymy and surname-overlap matrices, model outputs and analysis code for the study of the cultural-field model of electoral turnout on the Costa Rican electoral districts (six presidential result sets, 2010-2026), with a kinship kernel measured from the surnames of the national electoral roll. Companion to the manuscript "Where does the cultural field live? A slowly drifting kinship landscape, not a diffusing field, in Costa Rican turnout, 2010-2026".
